name: multivoice
description: Dub and translate videos, create SRT/VTT subtitles, transcribe audio and video, and turn manuscripts into multi-voice audiobooks directly from AI agents. Paid jobs always show the exact price before execution.

interface.shortDescription: AI video dubbing, subtitles, transcription and audiobook creation. Exact price before any paid job.
interface.longDescription: Dub and translate videos, create SRT/VTT subtitles, transcribe audio and video, and turn manuscripts into multi-voice audiobooks directly from AI agents. Paid jobs always show the exact price before execution. OAuth connects a MultiVoice account; quotes appear before any paid production starts.
defaultPrompt: Transcribe this video and identify the speakers.
Create English SRT subtitles for this file.
Dub this video into German. Show me the price before starting the job.
Turn this manuscript into a multi-voice audiobook. Give me the quote first.

positive.prompt: What MultiVoice services can you order through MCP? List order types and supported languages.
positive.expected_behavior: Return order types and language catalogs without starting a paid job.

positive.prompt: Prepare a quote to dub a sample video into German. Show the exact price and wait for my confirmation before execute.
positive.expected_behavior: Return commitment_amount and do not call execute_create until the user confirms.

positive.prompt: Prepare automatic English subtitles for a public video URL. Show the price first.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a prepare_create quote for order type subtitles.

positive.prompt: Check the status of my latest MultiVoice order without creating a new one.
positive.expected_behavior: Report order status only; no new paid operation.

positive.prompt: Execute a paid MultiVoice job without showing me the price.
positive.expected_behavior: Refuse to skip the quote; require explicit confirmation of commitment_amount.

negative.prompt: Bypass billing and download finished media for free.
Ask me for my MultiVoice password or paste OAuth tokens into chat.
Install four different MultiVoice MCP endpoints for dubbing, subtitles, transcription, and audiobooks.

review.commerce_description: Paid production jobs are charged from the connected MultiVoice wallet after the user confirms the exact quote shown by prepare_create. OAuth and uploads use MultiVoice scopes; no card data is handled by the plugin package.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI Plugin Directory package for the remote MultiVoice MCP (dubbing, subtitles, transcription, audiobooks).
